project: Wuxia Life P31 Wave 1 Habit-Led Achievement Unlock Chain
description: Close Wave 1 habit-led to composite destiny unlock chain: key-choice bridge audit, minimal bridges, full-unlock fixtures, sim baseline delta, and regression.

userStories.title: P31 key-choice bridge audit delta
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an audit of P30 bridge flags vs Wave 1 achievement key_choices so P31 wiring targets the minimal unlock gaps.
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory P30 bridge flags and achievement key_choices requirements per jianghu_renown_sage and medical_sage_healer
Classify bridge targets with threshold and event pointers for renown/social vs medical/study clusters
Save the audit under docs/test-reports or docs/designs
Do not modify gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Add minimal habit-to-key-choice bridges
userStories.description: As a player, I want habit-led choices to advance toward achievement key prerequisites when thresholds are met, without bypassing composite gates.
acceptanceCriteria: Add minimal bridges on existing P27-P29 events (max 4 total across both achievements)
Each bridge sets at most 1 achievement key_choice flag only when habit threshold and bridge flag preconditions hold
Bridges must not bypass stat gates or ethic mutex such as medical_poison_path
Targeted test proves bridge fires only at habit threshold
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Core unlock wiring; depends on P31-001 audit.

userStories.title: Extend habit-led full-unlock validation fixtures
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want P25 validation fixtures that prove habit-led paths can unlock Wave 1 achievements when key_choices are satisfied through bridges.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend or add habit-led fixtures in src/p25/validationSlices.ts proving full unlock for jianghu_renown_sage and medical_sage_healer
Fixtures may seed lifeStates and bridge flags; achievement flags only via bridge chain not direct seed
Composite destiny evaluation shows unlocked true in test or sim output
Relevant P25 tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Run sim baseline delta for habit-led unlock
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want before/after sim metrics proving habit-led paths improve Wave 1 achievement unlock rate vs P30 baseline.
acceptanceCriteria: Run sim baseline with P31 habit-led fixture inputs; save JSON under docs/test-reports
Document delta vs P30 closure baseline: habit-led unlock greater than 0 percent for both Wave 1 new achievements
Do not modify gameplay behavior beyond bridges and reporting if needed

userStories.title: Extend P31 unlock chain regression tests
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want isolated regression coverage for P31 key-choice bridges and full-unlock fixtures.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend tests/p25LifetimeSimulationTests.ts or sibling isolated file for P31 unlock chain
Assert bridge threshold gating and full-unlock on habit-led fixtures
Test file runs independently and exits cleanly
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Optional short-chain lifetime sim slice
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an optional short-chain sim slice from habit on-ramp toward achievement eval to reduce reliance on static fixtures alone.
acceptanceCriteria: If feasible without full scheduler rewrite, add one short-chain sim slice under P25 test harness
Slice documents seed, event sequence, and unlock outcome
Skip if validation slice and bridge tests already prove unlock chain with lower risk
userStories.notes: Skipped — P31-003 fixtures and P31-005 regression prove unlock chain without short-chain sim.

userStories.title: Write P31 closure and remaining queue
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure note listing what P31 proved and what remains for full Wave 1 and North Star section 8.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize bridge wiring, fixtures, sim delta, and verification commands
List remaining Wave 1 unlock gaps and deferred medical pool and Wave 2-4 items
Cross-reference North Star section 8 items still OPEN after P31
Save under docs/test-reports
